name: Are there any permits needed for bathroom sink installation in Henderson?

mainEntity.name: Are there any permits needed for bathroom sink installation in Henderson?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basic like-for-like bathroom sink replacements in Henderson, permits are generally not required if no changes are made to the existing plumbing rough-ins or structural elements. However, if the installation involves moving water lines, altering drain locations significantly, or performing other extensive plumbing modifications, a permit from the city of Henderson's building department may be necessary. We can advise you during our assessment if your specific project might require permitting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic sink replacements typically don't need permits in Henderson, but extensive plumbing modifications might.
